snippet.title: EMBLEMANIA - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Emblemania! - A fast paced, unrelenting point and click shoot-em- up where mania is just a click away!

Take of the mantle of the Shock Wave! A small but versatile fighter craft armed with the legendary Archemblem! An artifact of ancient origin, capable of siphoning dormant cosmic power through itself to unleash devastating results. Unleash it along with your own skills, wit, and reflexes against the legions of Viactrus forces seeking dominion over the Zyklon Galaxy! Our hope rests in your hands!

-----------------------------------------

This is my very first game, ever put into actual production, and its finally gotten to a point where I'm about ready to unveil it! Everything you see and hear in this trailer was developed, drawn and even composed by myself. I've been working on it in the background for some time now, and with the state its shaping up in, I plan on focusing much more heavily moving forward now that the full scope of the project is in view.

Currently, I would estimate the game is about 1/3 finished. The scale of what I'm going for isn't humongous or anything, this is intended to be a fairly straight forward shoot em up in terms of pacing after all. That said though, Its still too early for me to confidently give a time or date I feel I can get everything done by. I'd like to believe I'll have it out there at least by the end of next year, but its too early to say.

I plan on unveiling more about the project when the time is right to do so, likely once I've gotten a good chunk more of development through with. This is a one-man-band at the end of the day, outside of some much appreciated assistance and game testing from a few friends who I'd be dead in the water without, seriously, thank you guys! When updates do arrive, I plan on sharing them all with you promptly. For now though, I simply hope that you're all looking forward to the eventual release of this project as much as I am!
